tools.description: Search the 4ai.ai portfolio of premium .ai domain names for sale. Filter by a word in the name, a category (see list_categories), type and maximum length. Every result has an offer link.

category.description: Category key, e.g. short, numeric, quantum, crypto, tech, ai, code, space, health, gaming, commerce, places, brands

max_length.description: Maximum length of the name without .ai

query.description: Word to look for in the domain name or a category word, e.g. "quantum", "casino", "health"

tools.name: search_domains
tools.title: Search .ai domains for sale

tools.description: Details for one domain in the 4ai portfolio (for example "p0.ai"): categories, page, offer link, and comparable public .ai sales. Says so if the domain is not in the portfolio.
tools.name: get_domain
tools.title: Get a .ai domain

tools.description: Categories of .ai domains in the 4ai portfolio, with what they are good for and how many names each has.
tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories

tools.description: Free value estimate for any .ai domain name: auction, marketplace and brokerage values with likely ranges, the type of name, a short verdict and notes. Also says if the name is for sale on 4ai, with an offer link. Up to 100 names per call.
tools.name: estimate_domain_value
tools.title: Estimate the value of a .ai domain (free)

tools.description: Describe a company, product or idea in plain words (e.g. "telehealth app for mental health", "crypto casino", "quantum chip startup") and get the best-fitting .ai domains from the 4ai portfolio, ranked, each with the reason it fits and an offer link. Use this when the user asks for a .ai name for something.

description.description: What the project, company or product does, in any words

max_length.description: Maximum length of the name without .ai

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.title: Suggest .ai domains for a project

tools.description: Alternatives to a .ai domain: give any name (taken, too expensive, or one the user already likes) and get the closest .ai domains that are for sale on 4ai.
tools.name: similar_domains
tools.title: Similar .ai domains

tools.description: A link to the offer form for a 4ai domain with the amount (and an optional note) filled in. Nothing is sent: the user opens the link, checks the offer and sends it. Minimum offer $3,000.

note.description: Short message to the seller, e.g. what the domain is for. Optional, max 300 characters.

tools.name: get_offer_link
tools.title: Get an offer link

tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 .ai domain names side by side: length, type, words, whether 4ai sells it, estimated value ranges and a short verdict.
tools.name: compare_domains
tools.title: Compare .ai domains

tools.description: The steps, payment (Escrow.com), fees, minimum offer and transfer time for buying a .ai domain from 4ai. Use it when the user asks whether buying is safe or how it works.
tools.name: how_buying_works
tools.title: How buying a domain from 4ai works

tools.description: The biggest publicly reported .ai domain sales (price in USD, date, venue, source). Useful to estimate what a .ai domain is worth.

max_length.description: Only names up to this length without .ai

tools.name: ai_domain_sales
tools.title: Publicly reported .ai domain sales
